messages:
lia: heads-up: thinking about putting per-route permission controls inline on Routes page, but want an approval flow for quota/fallback toggles. thoughts?
kevin: inline for discoverability, but edits gated. admins can edit; everyone else sees preview.
maya: needs audit + export. compliance teams asked for a CSV history download last week.
samir: backend can return computed effective principals per-route already. we can expose GET /internal/v1/effective-scopes?route_id=... for preview. will add policy_source to traces.
tess: UX idea: small accordion on the Route row: "Permissions & Quotas" -> Preview | Request Change | History. Request Change opens a modal to submit a quota/override request.
lia: modal should show estimated cost delta and require an approver when delta > threshold. product to define threshold.
kevin: where do approval decisions live? should we integrate with existing approvals service (ticketing + email) or keep simple in-console approvals for org-admins?
maya: in-console is faster for admin teams; but exportable audit + ability to escalate to ticketing is necessary for large customers.
samir: implementation note: policy_level currently supports [global, route, token]; we can add an "approval_required" flag on route overrides and a request lifecycle: pending -> approved -> applied. backend already has immutable audit entries, we just need a request table.
deploy-bot: feature-flag rollout: "route-perm-approval" -> canary 5% orgs at 03:00 UTC :rocket:
kevin: telemetry: tag requests with policy_source=route|global and policy_change_via=request|console so we can attribute spikes. add metric policy_override_rate and approval_latency_ms.
tess: mockup will show: preview (read-only effective principals), a compact cost impact badge, and a CTA "Request override" if user cannot edit.
maya: for quotas, show projected 7/30/90-day spend based on current traffic and the requested quota. small inline calculator.
lia: retention: product suggests keep audit history 5 years for enterprise customers. we need to ensure export includes approver id, timestamps, and resulting policy snapshot.
samir: sample preview payload I can return (short):
```
route_id: generate-text-v2
effective_principals: [role:engineer, role:org_admin]
overrides: [{actor: "lia", ts: "2025-06-12T14:02:00Z", change: "increase quota to 200k/day", approval: "approved", approver: "kevin"}]
```
kevin: small security ask: only return "can_edit" boolean for the requesting principal; don't list internal role IDs unless the viewer is an admin.
tess: UX edge: support people need a "peek" mode to see who can do what without exposing edit capabilities. add a read-only effective permissions pane visible to support roles.
maya: also need a compliance export button on history: CSV with columns: route_id, change_ts, actor, action, old_value, new_value, approval_state, approver, approver_ts.
lia: rollout plan: 1) dark-launch preview for org-admins; 2) enable request flow (no auto-apply) for org-admins; 3) integrate approval path and export for enterprise; 4) flip for wider audience. collect approval_latency_ms and policy_override_rate.
samir: backend tasks: add preview endpoint, policy_source traces, request lifecycle API (POST /internal/v1/route-override-requests), webhook for approvals/tickets.
kevin: ops: create alert when policy_override_rate for any route spikes > 10x baseline in 1h. route owner should get a slack ping.
tess: i'll post annotated mocks in #design in 24-48h with accordion states and modal flows.
maya: product action: define approval thresholds (token/day & token/month) and decide which org tiers require auto-approval vs manual.
lia: action items summary: (1) tess: mockups & microcopy; (2) samir: preview endpoint + request lifecycle APIs + traces; (3) maya/lia: thresholds, retention policy, export spec; (4) kevin: telemetry alerts + rollout plan.
kevin: small microcopy suggestion in UI: "Changes here may affect cost and availability. Requests above your org threshold require admin approval." Keep it brief.
lia: thanks all 44d tagging @tess @samir @kevin for follow-ups.
console-bot: canary flag "route-perm-approval" enabled for 5% orgs
